title: 5. Gothic Cathedrals
speaker: Engineering Models
zh: 【Engineering Models】5. 哥德式大教堂（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Gothic Cathedrals represent one of the high points in Western architecture.
cues.en: Gothic Cathedrals represent one of the high points in Western architecture.
cues.zh: 哥德式大教堂代表了西方建築的高峰之一。

cues.text: Their builders wanted to construct places of worship with upwards looking spaces and light filled interiors –
cues.en: Their builders wanted to construct places of worship with upwards looking spaces and light filled interiors –
cues.zh: 他們的建造者希望建造具有向上看的空間和光線充足的內部空間的禮拜場所 -

cues.text: features that spoke of the God they worshiped.
cues.en: features that spoke of the God they worshiped.
cues.zh: 這些特徵講述了他們所崇拜的上帝。

cues.text: To realize these grand goals, generations of builders, from the 12 to 16th centuries,
cues.en: To realize these grand goals, generations of builders, from the 12 to 16th centuries,
cues.zh: 為了實現這些宏偉目標，從12世紀到16世紀的一代代建設者，

cues.text: were forced to make dramatic advances in both architecture and engineering.
cues.en: were forced to make dramatic advances in both architecture and engineering.
cues.zh: 被迫在建築和工程方面取得巨大進展。

cues.text: Their efforts gave rise to many innovations, including large buildings with complex vaulted ceilings,
cues.en: Their efforts gave rise to many innovations, including large buildings with complex vaulted ceilings,
cues.zh: 他們的努力催生了許多創新，包括具有複雜拱形天花板的大型建築，

cues.text: high stained-glass windows, pointed arches that reduce lateral loading,
cues.en: high stained-glass windows, pointed arches that reduce lateral loading,
cues.zh: 高高的彩色玻璃窗，減少橫向載重的尖拱，

cues.text: and flying buttresses that can support tall thin walls
cues.en: and flying buttresses that can support tall thin walls
cues.zh: 以及可以支撐又高又薄的牆壁的飛扶壁

cues.text: while letting the sun shine in.
cues.en: while letting the sun shine in.
cues.zh: 同時讓陽光照進來。

cues.text: For thousands of years leading up to this time, most buildings were constructed
cues.en: For thousands of years leading up to this time, most buildings were constructed
cues.zh: 在此之前的數千年裡，大多數建築物都是建造的

cues.text: using posts and beams.
cues.en: using posts and beams.
cues.zh: 使用柱子和橫樑。

cues.text: The vertical loads carried by the beams resulted in simple, vertical loads
cues.en: The vertical loads carried by the beams resulted in simple, vertical loads
cues.zh: 梁承受的垂直荷載導致簡單的垂直荷載

cues.text: in the posts or walls to which they were attached.
cues.en: in the posts or walls to which they were attached.
cues.zh: 在它們所附著的柱子或牆壁上。

cues.text: Beams, however, could not stretch across the much wider spaces required for the new cathedrals.
cues.en: Beams, however, could not stretch across the much wider spaces required for the new cathedrals.
cues.zh: 然而，橫梁無法延伸到新大教堂所需的更廣闊的空間。

cues.text: Arches, like this model or this simplified model,
cues.en: Arches, like this model or this simplified model,
cues.zh: 拱門，就像這個模型或這個簡化的模型，

cues.text: could span these large distances.
cues.en: could span these large distances.
cues.zh: 可以跨越這麼大的距離。

cues.text: However, they generated large, horizontal forces at their ends,
cues.en: However, they generated large, horizontal forces at their ends,
cues.zh: 然而，它們在末端產生了巨大的水平力，

cues.text: and they could collapse if those forces were not adequately resisted.
cues.en: and they could collapse if those forces were not adequately resisted.
cues.zh: 如果這些力量沒有得到充分抵抗，它們可能會崩潰。

cues.text: Short, thick walls might be able to resist these forces,
cues.en: Short, thick walls might be able to resist these forces,
cues.zh: 短而厚的牆壁也許能夠抵抗這些力量，

cues.text: but the cathedral designers wanted tall, thin ones.
cues.en: but the cathedral designers wanted tall, thin ones.
cues.zh: 但大教堂設計師想要又高又瘦的。

cues.text: And they wanted to put large glass windows in those walls so the sun could illuminate the inside of their cathedrals.
cues.en: And they wanted to put large glass windows in those walls so the sun could illuminate the inside of their cathedrals.
cues.zh: 他們想在這些牆上安裝大玻璃窗，這樣陽光就可以照亮大教堂的內部。

cues.text: The horizontal loads generated by arch ceilings would have easily pushed over the kinds of walls they wanted to build.
cues.en: The horizontal loads generated by arch ceilings would have easily pushed over the kinds of walls they wanted to build.
cues.zh: 拱形天花板產生的水平荷載很容易推過他們想要建造的牆壁。

cues.text: One possible solution to this problem was to pile stone on the outside of the building
cues.en: One possible solution to this problem was to pile stone on the outside of the building
cues.zh: 解決這個問題的一個可能的解決方案是在建築物的外部堆砌石頭

cues.text: so as to support the wall.
cues.en: so as to support the wall.
cues.zh: 從而支撐牆壁。

cues.text: Over time, the engineers developed structures called buttresses,
cues.en: Over time, the engineers developed structures called buttresses,
cues.zh: 隨著時間的推移，工程師們發展了一種叫做扶壁的結構，

cues.text: and these elegant structures can be found in many early Gothic cathedrals.
cues.en: and these elegant structures can be found in many early Gothic cathedrals.
cues.zh: 這些優雅的結構在許多早期哥德式大教堂中都能找到。

cues.text: Unfortunately, they tend to block the sunlight, as this model demonstrates.
cues.en: Unfortunately, they tend to block the sunlight, as this model demonstrates.
cues.zh: 不幸的是，正如該模型所示，它們往往會阻擋陽光。

cues.text: In time, designers figured out how to build thin lateral supports called flying buttresses.
cues.en: In time, designers figured out how to build thin lateral supports called flying buttresses.
cues.zh: 隨著時間的推移，設計師們找到如何建造稱為飛扶壁的薄型橫向支撐。

cues.text: The earlier buttress designs were essentially broken into separate tall pieces
cues.en: The earlier buttress designs were essentially broken into separate tall pieces
cues.zh: 早期的扶壁設計基本上被分成單獨的高塊

cues.text: and moved a short distance from the side of the building.
cues.en: and moved a short distance from the side of the building.
cues.zh: 並從建築物的側面移動了一小段距離。

cues.text: The resulting tall sections were called piers, and they were connected to each other
cues.en: The resulting tall sections were called piers, and they were connected to each other
cues.zh: 由此產生的高部分稱為橋墩，它們相互連線

cues.text: and to the side of the cathedral using sloped, arch-like members called flyers.
cues.en: and to the side of the cathedral using sloped, arch-like members called flyers.
cues.zh: 大教堂的側面使用傾斜的拱形構件，稱為傳單。

cues.text: As this model demonstrates, flying buttresses kept the tall, thin walls from collapsing,
cues.en: As this model demonstrates, flying buttresses kept the tall, thin walls from collapsing,
cues.zh: 正如這個模型所展示的，飛扶壁可以防止又高又薄的牆壁倒塌，

cues.text: and they allowed the sun to shine in.
cues.en: and they allowed the sun to shine in.
cues.zh: 他們讓陽光照進來。

cues.text: This drawing shows how the forces from the vaulted ceilings were transferred to the flyers
cues.en: This drawing shows how the forces from the vaulted ceilings were transferred to the flyers
cues.zh: 這張圖顯示了拱形天花板的力如何傳遞到傳單上

cues.text: and then down through the piers to the ground.
cues.en: and then down through the piers to the ground.
cues.zh: 然後穿過橋墩到達地面。

cues.text: Spires and other heavy architectural features were sometimes placed on the tops of the piers
cues.en: Spires and other heavy architectural features were sometimes placed on the tops of the piers
cues.zh: 尖塔和其他重型建築特徵有時被放置在橋墩的頂部

cues.text: so that the lateral components of the arch forces could be more efficiently transferred to the ground.
cues.en: so that the lateral components of the arch forces could be more efficiently transferred to the ground.
cues.zh: 使拱形力的橫向分量能夠更有效地傳遞到地面。

cues.text: By spires, we mean the high, pointed tips of the piers.
cues.en: By spires, we mean the high, pointed tips of the piers.
cues.zh: 我們所說的尖塔是指橋墩的高而尖的尖端。

cues.text: As you can see, the resulting buttress systems can be quite complicated.
cues.en: As you can see, the resulting buttress systems can be quite complicated.
cues.zh: 正如您所看到的，最終的支撐系統可能非常複雜。

cues.text: Since the designers did not have computers to help them, they relied on scale models,
cues.en: Since the designers did not have computers to help them, they relied on scale models,
cues.zh: 由於設計師沒有計算機來幫助他們，他們依靠比例模型，

cues.text: though much more sophisticated ones than ours.
cues.en: though much more sophisticated ones than ours.
cues.zh: 儘管比我們的複雜得多。

cues.text: Those models helped them to fine tune their designs, and they showed them the right order
cues.en: Those models helped them to fine tune their designs, and they showed them the right order
cues.zh: 這些模型幫助他們微調設計，並向他們展示了正確的順序

cues.text: in which to build the various parts of the cathedral so that it would remain stable during construction.
cues.en: in which to build the various parts of the cathedral so that it would remain stable during construction.
cues.zh: 建造大教堂的各個部分，以使其在施工過程中保持穩定。

cues.text: In what order should the components of this cathedral be built?
cues.en: In what order should the components of this cathedral be built?
cues.zh: 這座大教堂的各個組成部分應該以什麼順序建造？

cues.text: Let’s try building the shell of the building first.
cues.en: Let’s try building the shell of the building first.
cues.zh: 我們先嘗試建造建築物的外殼。

cues.text: Oh, that turns out to be a poor choice.
cues.en: Oh, that turns out to be a poor choice.
cues.zh: 哦，事實證明這是一個糟糕的選擇。

cues.text: It’s a good thing that this is just a model.
cues.en: It’s a good thing that this is just a model.
cues.zh: 幸好這只是模型。

cues.text: Let’s try again.
cues.en: Let’s try again.
cues.zh: 我們再試一次。

cues.text: This time, let’s work toward the center, and start with the most distant flyer.
cues.en: This time, let’s work toward the center, and start with the most distant flyer.
cues.zh: 這次，讓我們向中心努力，從最遠的飛行物開始。

cues.text: Then add the inner flyer.
cues.en: Then add the inner flyer.
cues.zh: 然後新增內部傳單。

cues.text: And finally add the arch.
cues.en: And finally add the arch.
cues.zh: 最後新增拱門。

cues.text: If we take our hands away, the cathedral model stands.
cues.en: If we take our hands away, the cathedral model stands.
cues.zh: 如果我們把手拿開，大教堂模型就會矗立起來。

cues.text: The model has taught us that this is a much better construction plan.
cues.en: The model has taught us that this is a much better construction plan.
cues.zh: 該模型告訴我們，這是一個更好的施工計劃。

cues.text: Once the stonework in a cathedral was finally completed, it was typically covered with a slate-shingled wooden roof to keep off the rain.
cues.en: Once the stonework in a cathedral was finally completed, it was typically covered with a slate-shingled wooden roof to keep off the rain.
cues.zh: 大教堂的石雕工程最終完成後，通常會覆蓋上石板瓦木屋頂以避雨。

cues.text: We hope this video helps you to understand why Gothic Cathedrals are such a triumph of architecture and engineering.
cues.en: We hope this video helps you to understand why Gothic Cathedrals are such a triumph of architecture and engineering.
cues.zh: 我們希望這段影片可以幫助您瞭解為什麼哥德式大教堂是建築和工程的勝利。

cues.text: Besides their beauty, many Gothic Cathedrals have remained in service
cues.en: Besides their beauty, many Gothic Cathedrals have remained in service
cues.zh: 除了它們的美麗之外，許多哥德式大教堂仍然在使用

cues.text: for more than 700 years, and they continue to inspire those who visit them.
cues.en: for more than 700 years, and they continue to inspire those who visit them.
cues.zh: 700 多年來，它們一直激勵著參觀它們的人們。

cues.text: We hope you will consider watching some of our other “Engineering Models” videos.
cues.en: We hope you will consider watching some of our other “Engineering Models” videos.
cues.zh: 我們希望您考慮觀看我們的其他一些“工程模型”影片。
